tenderSchedule.title: PROCUREMENT OF ELECTRICAL SPARES
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office BTPS Bellary

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The tenderer, as authorized representative/dealer , has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least xxxxx % of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least xxxxx months on the date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.
The legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the company or firm or partnership.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

The bidder should have supplied similar type of materials purchase order value Rs.54,000/- for thermal power plant / other industries in a Single Purchase Order issued in the last five financial years (2020-21 to 2024-25) and same documents issued from the competent authority shall be uploaded in e-portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Agency shall furnish past PO copies

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be Manufacturer /Authorised Dealer/ Supplier of ELECTRICAL SPARES. The Agency shall furnish documentary proof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Agency shall furnish Manufacturer /Authorised Dealer/ Supplier  certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have proven financial capability and have an average annual turnover of Rs.1.08 lakh/- for any two years among previous five years (2020-21 to 2024-25). The bidder shall furnish a copy of turnover certificate along with Profit & Loss account statement, duly certified by a charted accountant to establish annual turnover requirement.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as a documentary proof.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate along with P&L statements
